basis: Standard paid-tier API-equivalent estimates for the Gemini Developer API, not subscription charges, provider-reported spending or invoices. No batch, priority, data-residency, regional or negotiated adjustments. The Gemini Developer API pricing page moved from https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (now a redirect) to https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, whose HTML is a JavaScript shell; the Markdown mirror at /docs/pricing.md is the retained source, and pageContentSha256 is the SHA-256 of its raw bytes. Gemini 2.5 Pro keeps its published rates and its per-request tier (a prompt over 200,000 tokens, counting cache reads and tool tokens, pays the above rates for the whole request) through 2026-11-30. Google has deprecated the model: effective 2026-12-01 every API request to gemini-2.5-pro automatically routes to Gemini 3.8 Flash and is billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates, which have no prompt-size tier, so each scheduledRates entry carries the 3.8 Flash paid-tier rates in force from its date; the 2027-01-01 entry is the published end of the 3.8 Flash introductory pricing. Output includes thinking tokens and cacheRead is the context caching price; per-token-hour storage prices are not estimated. The page names no time zone, so each change applies by the usage's UTC day. Earlier evidence files are retained unchanged.
